tests: All reviewed additive Prisma migrations apply to a fresh isolated database
Attributes are reusable; duplicate tenant codes reject while another tenant can reuse the code
Invalid types, executable metadata, malformed swatches, units and ranges reject
Industry-independent keyboard, clothing and vehicle schema fixtures reuse the same attribute identity
Duplicate bindings, widened validation, foreign attributes and incorrect axis/scope reject
Active schema and nested fields/groups/options are immutable in both API and PostgreSQL
Referenced options cannot be deleted/archived and approved snapshots retain vocabulary meaning
Cloning creates a separate draft; stale writes and concurrent activation conflict safely
Tenant A/B reads, edits, approval and activation remain isolated
Store-only and narrowly delegated multiple roles cannot approve, activate or escalate schema rights
Milestone 3 SQL preserves populated Milestone 2 records on upgrade
Category creation, metadata, bounded pagination and cross-store references
Shared product/category URL reservations and immutable legacy route ownership
Hierarchy cycles, concurrent moves, subtree bounds and archive dependencies
Published hierarchy snapshots survive draft edits and stale writes are rejected
Multiple compatible Product Types and shared SKU attribute filter compilation
Invalid operators, numeric units/ranges, private and foreign schema references fail closed
Immutable active filters, independent drafts, published aliases and optimistic activation
Synthetic preview supports multiple industries, descendants, mixed types and canonical URLs
Custom store roles restrict category/filter creation, approvals, tenant edits and store reassignment
Archived/private dependencies invalidate public contracts; archive preserves identities and history
Category/filter events remain store-audited and static 12-category/84-product URLs are unchanged
Milestone 4 additive SQL preserves existing users, categories and schema records on upgrade
Default retail SKU, typed false/zero/missing and required schema validation
Only explicit keyboard combinations exist; duplicate combinations and tenant SKU codes reject
Derived mouse sensors and apparel variants resolve without inventing selectable axes
Inquiry-only SKU-free policy is schema-approved and cannot bypass retail SKU validation
Published facts and physical SKU identities are immutable; stale edits and competing publication conflict
Store listings pin exact approved revisions, multiple categories and SKU facts
Schema impact reports real products/SKUs/listings and blocks unsafe required field activation
Tenant/store isolation, scoped custom roles, forbidden references and schema privileges fail closed
New catalog publications preserve old listing pins; listing repins are explicit and concurrency checked
Tenant catalog editor custom role cannot approve, publish, add SKUs or edit tenant schemas
Shared gallery/poster, variant and listing media references are ordered, scoped and immutable after review
Actual foreign product/store identities cannot cross compound catalog boundaries
Milestone 5 additive migration preserves populated catalog and media facts
Approved store offers, exact amounts, scheduling, expiry and reference-only gating
Invalid currency precision, discounts, overlapping windows and stale price approvals reject
The same catalog SKU has independent offers in two explicitly authorized stores
Unknown stock, verified zero, quantity counts and append-only history are distinct
Concurrent quantity adjustments, idempotent retries, negative stock and explicit invalidation are safe
Cross-store locations, non-quantity policies and stale catalog drafts cannot overwrite stock or prices
Real signature validation, private local WebP derivatives and idempotent image upload work
Media rights approval, ordered shared/SKU posters, stale reordering and published references are protected
Foreign media, unapproved rights and unauthorized operations fail closed
ISO minor units accept fractional PKR and JPY store precision without display rounding
Custom store roles cannot approve prices, adjust inventory, escalate or cross stores
Development-only rights allow shared catalog review but cannot enter a public store presentation
Foreign media identities, count and byte quotas, traversal and failed-upload cleanup are enforced
Public projection includes only published pinned store data and rejects forged scope, Host and internal fields
Real filters use one offered SKU for color, dependent switch, approved price and verified stock; facets count distinct products
Parent categories, mixed industries, pagination, reference-only prices and unknown inventory remain truthful
Dependent SKU details expose actual options, sensors and apparel combinations without private specifications
Approved shared gallery and ordered variant posters are delivered through checked public media, never private storage
Mixed-type filters preserve shared attribute meaning, canonical units, false values and registered brand semantics
Public query stays bounded with 200 extra published records and an equally published foreign-store twin
Real production-built dynamic storefront filters, dependent variants, posters, responsive layouts, SEO and homepage limits pass
Runtime publication resolves without rebuilding, routes reject collisions and sitemap reflects published records
Unavailable dynamic backend shows no static price or stock fallback
Real admin attribute/option/type creation, form preview, lifecycle, clone and responsive browser workflows
Privileged mutations are tenant-audited without tokens, passwords or database URLs
